description: The file defines a Java interface 'DelinquencyReadPlatformService' which declares methods related to delinquency data retrieval and calculations within a loan management context. It serves as a contract for implementing classes to provide delinquency-related functionalities.

classes.name: DelinquencyReadPlatformService
classes.description: A service interface that declares methods for retrieving and calculating delinquency-related data for loans.

methods.name: retrieveAllDelinquencyRanges
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all delinquency ranges.

methods.name: retrieveDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Retrieves a specific delinquency range by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Retrieves a specific delinquency bucket by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveCurrentDelinquencyTag
methods.description: Retrieves the current delinquency tag for a given loan.

methods.name: retrieveDelinquencyRangeHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the delinquency range history for a specific loan.

methods.name: calculateLoanCollectionData
methods.description: Calculates collection data for a loan.

methods.name: calculateAvailableDisbursementAmountWithOverApplied
methods.description: Calculates the available disbursement amount for a loan, considering over-applied amounts.

methods.name: retrieveLoanInstallmentsCurrentDelinquencyTag
methods.description: Retrieves the current delinquency tags for loan installments.

methods.name: retrieveLoanDelinquencyActions
methods.description: Retrieves actions that can be performed for loan delinquency.
